"""Register actual consumed prerequisite rechecks without inventing new reads."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
queue_path = Path('/tmp/range-reader-prerequisite-rechecks.json')
state = json.loads(queue_path.read_text())
digest = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def section(source):
    name, lesson = source.split('#')
    raw = (root / name).read_bytes()
    headings = list(re.finditer(rb'(?m)^## ([A-Z\d]+\.\d+) [^\r\n]+', raw))
    for index, heading in enumerate(headings):
        if heading[1].decode() == lesson:
            return raw[heading.start():headings[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(headings) else len(raw)]
    raise ValueError(source)

assert not state['active']
assert len(state['queue']) == len(state['done']) == 3
assert {item['id'] for item in state['queue']} == set(state['done'])
journal_path = 'docs/course-experiments/review-dispatch/root-reader.json'
journal = json.loads((root / journal_path).read_bytes())
results = {}
for event in journal['events']:
    if event.get('event') == 'result' and event.get('report_sha256'):
        results[event['lesson_id']] = event
records = []
for item in state['queue']:
    lesson = item['id']
    consumed = state['done'][lesson]
    report_path = f'docs/reader-reviews/{lesson}.json'
    raw = (root / report_path).read_bytes()
    report = json.loads(raw)
    assert digest(raw) == consumed['report_sha256'] == results[lesson]['report_sha256']
    assert report['reviewer_task'] == consumed['task'] == results[lesson]['reviewer_task']
    assert report['verdict'] == 'pass'
    assert report['source'] == item['source']
    assert report['source_sha256'] == digest(section(item['source']))
    old_raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', item['original_report_fixed_git_ref']], cwd=root)
    assert digest(old_raw) == item['original_report_sha256']
    full = bool(item.get('blocked_original_task') or item.get('full_replacement_task'))
    prerequisites = {record['source']: record for record in report['prerequisites_read']} if full else report['range_prerequisite_rechecks']
    actual_support = []
    for prerequisite in item['actual_changed_prerequisites']:
        expected = state['changed_prerequisites'][prerequisite]
        assert digest(section(expected['source'])) == expected['current_source_sha256']
        record = prerequisites[expected['source']] if full else prerequisites[prerequisite]
        assert record['source_sha256'] == expected['current_source_sha256'] and record['details']
        if not full:
            assert record['old_source_sha256'] == expected['old_source_sha256']
            assert record['actual_reread'] is True
        actual_support.append({'source': expected['source'], 'source_sha256': record['source_sha256'], 'details': record['details']})
    records.append({
        'lesson_id': lesson,
        'mode': 'actual_full_fresh_replacement' if full else 'actual_original_reader_narrow_recheck',
        'reviewer_task': report['reviewer_task'],
        'report': report_path,
        'report_sha256': digest(raw),
        'current_primary_source_sha256': report['source_sha256'],
        'previous_report_fixed_git_ref': item['original_report_fixed_git_ref'],
        'previous_report_sha256': item['original_report_sha256'],
        'actual_changed_prerequisites_read': actual_support,
        'actual_consumption_record': consumed,
        'root_journal_result': results[lesson],
        'blocked_original_task': item.get('blocked_original_task'),
        'replaced_previous_task_after_primary_author_correction': item.get('original_task_before_author_full_replacement'),
    })
receipt = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'checked_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'checkout_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    'status': 'passed',
    'scope': 'Root generated this dated registry from genuine consumed FINALs and verified current report, task, own section and necessary prerequisite identities. It registers three actual dependent original-reader narrow rechecks after the17.12 feature-range condition prose correction. There were no blocked attempts or fresh replacements in this queue; the changed primary17.12 receives its own FULL fresh reader review.17.14 andT.9 explicitly did not previously read17.12 and are excluded from this queue. Original CPU and SVG inspection dates in reports are unchanged. This identity program does not conduct a new reading, execute kernels, judge factual accuracy, claim all technical reviews are finished, or claim publication.',
    'count': len(records),
    'full_fresh_count': sum(record['mode'] == 'actual_full_fresh_replacement' for record in records),
    'original_narrow_count': sum(record['mode'] == 'actual_original_reader_narrow_recheck' for record in records),
    'changed_prerequisites': state['changed_prerequisites'],
    'blocked_original_attempts': state['blocked_attempts'],
    'journal': journal_path,
    'journal_sha256_at_check': digest((root / journal_path).read_bytes()),
    'records': records,
    'verification_program': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
target = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts/range-prerequisite-reader-rechecks.json'
assert not target.exists(), 'Preserve prior receipts instead of overwriting history'
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: receipt[key] for key in ['checked_at', 'checkout_revision', 'status', 'count', 'full_fresh_count', 'original_narrow_count']}))
